image_location_description: Lower right of the figure (viewer’s right leg); mirrored tan/gold striping on white leg

steps.title: Foot sole + toe corners
steps.description: Place 3021 White 2x3 plate; add 2x 3024 White 1x1 plates at front corners.

steps.title: Build boot top
steps.description: On sole add 3003 White 2x2 brick (rear), 2x 3005 White 1x1 (front), 3004 White 1x2 between.

steps.title: Calf layer 1
steps.description: Stack 3004 White 1x2 (inner side) + 3004 Tan 1x2 (outer side) on the boot top.

steps.title: Calf layer 2 + knee band
steps.description: Repeat inner White 1x2 + outer Tan 1x2; add 3749 Tan 2x2 on front as knee stripe.

steps.title: Thigh stack
steps.description: Add 3004 White 1x2 (inner) + 3004 Tan 1x2 (outer); cap with 2x 3004 White 1x2.

steps.title: Hip platform (wide)
steps.description: Add 3021 White 2x3 plate on top; add 2x 3005 White 1x1 on inner edge for hip width.

steps.title: Tan accent stripes
steps.description: Attach 2x 3023 Tan 1x2 plates on outer calf/thigh to mirror left leg striping.

steps.title: Gold accent dot
steps.description: Place 26047 PearlGold detail on outer knee area for the gold highlight.
